definitions.gloss: cutting corners; sloppy work; half-hearted effort
definitions.explanation: Deliberately doing less work than required or skipping steps to save time or effort, often resulting in lower quality.

examples.japanese: {手抜|てぬ}き{工事|こうじ}が{問題|もんだい}になった。
examples.english: Shoddy construction work became a problem.

examples.japanese: {掃除|そうじ}を{手抜|てぬ}きしてしまった。
examples.english: I cut corners on the cleaning.

examples.japanese: {手抜|てぬ}き{料理|りょうり}でも{美味|おい}しくできる。
examples.english: Even easy-prep meals can turn out delicious.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{手|て} (hand) + {抜|ぬ}き (omitting, skipping) - literally removing hands from the work.

USAGE:
Can be:
・Negative: implying sloppy or irresponsible work
・Neutral/positive: when referring to efficient shortcuts ({手抜|てぬ}き{料理|りょうり} = easy recipes)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{手抜|てぬ}き{工事|こうじ} - shoddy construction
・{手抜|てぬ}き{料理|りょうり} - easy-prep cooking

COLLOCATIONS:
・{手抜|てぬ}きをする - to cut corners
・{手抜|てぬ}きが{見|み}つかる - corner-cutting is discovered
